title: Dandelion | Spacious 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Stay at Dandelion, a spacious WaterColor home with modern comforts. Ideal for a relaxing and comfortable stay.
description_expanded: Dandelion - Americana-Coastal Luxury in the Heart of WaterColor About This Home Welcome to Dandelion, a welcoming 3,400-sq-ft designer home in the original WaterColor community - where Americana charm meets coastal sophistication. Located directly across from the WaterColor Tennis Center and minutes from Seaside, this home offers one of the most desirable locations in all of WaterColor. This spacious retreat features a brand-new kitchen, updated bathrooms, and décor inspired by an Americana-meets-beachy aesthetic - airy, welcoming, and stylishly comfortable. Homes this close to the front of the neighborhood are rare - reserve early before your dates are gone! Highlights - Prime Location: Across from WaterColor Tennis Center - 5 Complimentary Taxi Bikes - explore WaterColor, Seaside, and the Beach Club in minutes - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 60 pounds or less. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Driveway Parking for 4 Vehicles - Porch and Balcony Overlooking Nature Preserve and Walking Trail - Gas Grill and Outdoor Adirondack Seating - Private Outdoor Shower - Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor and Heated Community Pools (for up to 14 guests ages 5+) - Laundry Room with Washer and Dryer Living Spaces Main Living Area (2nd Floor) Open-concept great room with 20-ft wood-beamed ceilings, a fully equipped chef's kitchen, dining for 13, and double French doors leading to a screened balcony with dining for 10 and a cushioned sitting area. Second Living Room (1st Floor) A family-friendly space perfect for kids or movie nights - featuring a sectional sofa, flat-screen TV, DVD player, and a library of children's books. Outdoor Spaces Enjoy the front porch swing with views of the Tennis Center or unwind on the balcony overlooking the nature preserve and walking trail. Location You'll be right in the heart of WaterColor - an unbeatable location to enjoy everything 30A offers: - 2-min bike ride to Camp WaterColor - 3-min bike ride to Seaside (via Viridian Drive cut-through) - 4-min bike ride to WaterColor Beach Club and Gulf of Mexico Kick off your shoes and sink your feet into the powder-white sand and emerald-green waters that make this area world-famous. Booking Notes - Nightly and weekly rates available year-round (seasonal minimums apply) - Reservation requests are confirmed within 24 hours of booking - Guests must be 25+ years old to reserve and must occupy the home during the stay - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Suite 1 | views of a nature preserve, closet storage, workspace with desk and chair, renovated ensuite bath with vanity sink and walk-in shower
2nd Floor King Suite 2 | views of a nature preserve, closet and dresser storage, flat screen TV and DVD player, renovated ensuite bath with dual vanity sink and walk-in shower
1st Floor King Suite 3 | views of a nature preserve, closet and dresser storage, flat screen TV and DVD player, renovated ensuite bath with dual vanity sink and walk-in shower

1st Floor Bunk Room | Sleeps 4 in two Twin over Twin Bunk Beds. dresser and closet storage, built in ladder and guard rails on top bunks for safety, individual lights for each bunk, adjacent to full bath with his and hers vanity sinks plus combination shower/tub

1st Floor Guest Room | Sleeps 4 in a Twin over Twin bunk and a Queen Bed. dresser and closet storage, built in ladder and guard rails on top bunks for safety, individual lights for each bunk, adjacent to full bath with his and hers vanity sinks plus combination shower/tub
Bonus - 2nd Floor Twin Daybed | Hallway Twin Daybed on 2nd Floor landing

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
